_comment: Ratchet floors for coverage metrics a package DECLARES but that measured BELOW the declaration. check-coverage.ts compared statements only, so these were declared-but-unenforced. An entry is the measured value at seeding: the gate fails if a metric drops BELOW its floor, and warns while it sits under the package's own declared threshold. Floors may only TIGHTEN -- run `bun scripts/check-coverage.ts --update-baseline` after genuinely improving one, never to absorb a regression. Remove the entry once the package meets its declaration.
_seeded: from a green main Coverage (Full) run
